lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਪੜਤਾਲ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag bhairau mahalaa 5 paRataal ghar 3 ||
lines.translation: Raag Bhairao, Fifth Mehl, Partaal, Third House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਕਵਨ ਗੁਨ ਗਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: paratipaal prabh kripaal kavan gun ganee ||
lines.translation: God is the Compassionate Cherisher. Who can count His Glorious Virtues?

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਰੰਗ ਬਹੁ ਤਰੰਗ ਸਰਬ ਕੋ ਧਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: anik ra(n)g bahu tara(n)g sarab ko dhanee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Countless colors, and countless waves of joy; He is the Master of all. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਗਿਆਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਧਿਆਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਜਾਪ ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ॥
lines.transliteration: anik giaan anik dhiaan anik jaap jaap taap ||
lines.translation: Endless spiritual wisdom, endless meditations, endless chants, intense meditations and austere self-disciplines.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਗੁਨਿਤ ਧੁਨਿਤ ਲਲਿਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਧਾਰ ਮੁਨੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: anik gunit dhunit lalit anik dhaar munee ||1||
lines.translation: Countless virtues, musical notes and playful sports; countless silent sages enshrine Him in their hearts. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਨਾਦ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਜ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਅਨਿਕ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਅਨਿਕ ਦੋਖ ਅਨਿਕ ਰੋਗ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਜਸ ਸੁਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: anik naad anik baaj nimakh nimakh anik svaad anik dokh anik rog mitahi jas sunee ||
lines.translation: Countless melodies, countless instruments, countless tastes, each and every instant. Countless mistakes and countless diseases are removed by hearing His Praise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਵ ਅਪਾਰ ਦੇਵ ਤਟਹ ਖਟਹ ਬਰਤ ਪੂਜਾ ਗਵਨ ਭਵਨ ਜਾਤ੍ਰ ਕਰਨ ਸਗਲ ਫਲ ਪੁਨੀ ॥੨॥੧॥੫੭॥੮॥੨੧॥੭॥੫੭॥੯੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sev apaar dev tatah khatah barat poojaa gavan bhavan jaatr karan sagal phal punee ||2||1||57||8||21||7||57||93||
lines.translation: O Nanak, serving the Infinite, Divine Lord, one earns all the rewards and merits of performing the six rituals, fasts, worship services, pilgrimages to sacred rivers, and journeys to sacred shrines. ||2||1||57||8||21||7||57||93||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhairau asatapadeeaa mahalaa 1 ghar 2 ||
lines.translation: Bhairao, Ashtpadheeyaa, First Mehl, Second House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਾਮ ਮਹਿ ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨਸਿ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aatam mahi raam raam mahi aatam cheenas gur beechaaraa ||
lines.translation: The Lord is in the soul, and the soul is in the Lord. This is realized through the Guru's Teachings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟੈ ਹਉ ਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit baanee sabad pachhaanee dukh kaatai hau maaraa ||1||
lines.translation: The Ambrosial Word of the Guru's Bani is realized through the Word of the Shabad. Sorrow is dispelled, and egotism is eliminated. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗ ਬੁਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak haumai rog bure ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the disease of egotism is so very deadly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾਂ ਤਹ ਏਕਾ ਬੇਦਨ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਧੁਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jah dekhaa(n) tah ekaa bedan aape bakhasai sabad dhure ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Wherever I look, I see the pain of the same disease. The Primal Lord Himself bestows the Shabad of His Word. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪਰਖੇ ਪਰਖਣਹਾਰੈ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਸੂਲਾਕੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape parakhe parakhanahaarai bahur soolaak na hoee ||
lines.translation: When the Appraiser Himself appraises the mortal, then he is not tested again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਭਈ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jin kau nadar bhaee gur mele prabh bhaanaa sach soee ||2||
lines.translation: Those who are blessed with His Grace meet with the Guru. They alone are true, who are pleasing to God. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਰੋਗੀ ਰੋਗੀ ਧਰਤਿ ਸਭੋਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: paun paanee baisa(n)tar rogee rogee dharat sabhogee ||
lines.translation: Air, water and fire are diseased; the world with its enjoyments is diseased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇਹ ਸਿ ਰੋਗੀ ਰੋਗੀ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: maat pitaa maaiaa deh s rogee rogee kuta(n)b sa(n)jogee ||3||
lines.translation: Mother, father, Maya and the body are diseased; those united with their relatives are diseased. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੋਗੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਸਰੁਦ੍ਰਾ ਰੋਗੀ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: rogee brahamaa bisan sarudraa rogee sagal sa(n)saaraa ||
lines.translation: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva are diseased; the whole world is diseased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਭਏ ਸੇ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: har pad cheen bhae se mukate gur kaa sabad veechaaraa ||4||
lines.translation: Those who remember the Lord's Feet and contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad are liberated. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੋਗੀ ਸਾਤ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸਨਦੀਆ ਖੰਡ ਪਤਾਲ ਸਿ ਰੋਗਿ ਭਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: rogee saat samu(n)d sanadeeaa kha(n)d pataal s rog bhare ||
lines.translation: The seven seas are diseased, along with the rivers; the continents and the nether regions of the underworlds are full of disease.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਕ ਸਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਸਰਬੀ ਥਾਈ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: har ke lok s saach suhele sarabee thaaee nadar kare ||5||
lines.translation: The people of the Lord dwell in Truth and peace; He blesses them with His Grace everywhere. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੋਗੀ ਖਟ ਦਰਸਨ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਾ ਹਠੀ ਅਨੇਕਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: rogee khat darasan bhekhadhaaree naanaa hathee anekaa ||
lines.translation: The six Shaastras are diseased, as are the many who follow the different religious orders.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਹ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਨਹ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਇਕ ਏਕਾ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: bed kateb karahi kah bapure nah boojhahi ik ekaa ||6||
lines.translation: What can the poor Vedas and Bibles do? People do not understand the One and Only Lord. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਠ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਇ ਸੁ ਰੋਗਿ ਭਰੀਜੈ ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: mith ras khaai s rog bhareejai ka(n)d mool sukh naahee ||
lines.translation: Eating sweet treats, the mortal is filled with disease; he finds no peace at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਅਨ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਹੀ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: naam visaar chalahi an maarag a(n)t kaal pachhutaahee ||7||
lines.translation: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they walk on other paths, and at the very last moment, they regret and repent. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਭਰਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਪੜਿਆ ਬਾਦੁ ਬਿਬਾਦੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: teerath bharamai rog na chhootas paRiaa baad bibaad bhaiaa ||
lines.translation: Wandering around at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, the mortal is not cured of his disease. Reading scripture, he gets involved in useless arguments.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਸੁ ਅਧਿਕ ਵਡੇਰਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਮੁਹਤਾਜੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: dubidhaa rog s adhik vaderaa maaiaa kaa muhataaj bhaiaa ||8||
lines.translation: The disease of duality is so very deadly; it causes dependence on Maya. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh saachaa sabad salaahai man saachaa tis rog gaiaa ||
lines.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh and praises the True Shabad with the True Lord in his mind is cured of his disease.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕਰਮਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ਪਇਆ ॥੯॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak har jan anadin niramal jin kau karam neesaan paiaa ||9||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the humble servant of the Lord is immaculate, night and day; he bears the insignia of the Lord's Grace. ||9||1||
